text: Freedom from supervision and disclosure obligations was functional rather than incidental for hedge funds: it enabled successful fund launches, helped generate higher returns, and attracted investors, which is why manager registration is contested.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Fund Manager Registration Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2150377

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Fund Manager Registration Under the Dodd-Frank Act

abstract: Hedge funds' ability to invest in global markets without supervision and significant disclosure obligations was important for successful hedge fund launches, helped generate higher returns, and attracted investors.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: hedge funds operating before the Dodd-Frank Act
